def _sass_binary_impl(ctx):

        ctx.files.srcs,
        transitive = [dep[SassInfo].transitive_srcs for dep in ctx.attr.deps],

        arguments = [args],
        inputs = transitive,
        outputs = [out],

    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out])), SassInfo(transitive_srcs = transitive)]

def _checksum_impl(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".sha256")
    args = ctx.actions.args()
    args.add_all(ctx.files.srcs)
    ctx.actions.run_shell(
        inputs = ctx.files.srcs,
        outputs = [out],
        arguments = [args],
        command = "sha256sum \"$@\" > " + out.path,
    )
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

checksum = rule(
    implementation = _checksum_impl,
    attrs = {"srcs": attr.label_list(allow_files = True)},
)

notes: clean: small rule with run_shell using sha256sum and declared inputs
